title: MECHA — Pilotage industriel multi-sites
description: Vue consolidée des 5 usines pour la Direction industrielle.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'site_fr1' AS "Site", count(*) AS "Machines à risque"
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (machine_id) machine_id, shared.niveau_depuis_rul(rul_predit) AS risk_level_predit
      FROM site_fr1.predictions ORDER BY machine_id, "timestamp" DESC) d
WHERE risk_level_predit = 'a_risque'
UNION ALL

FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (machine_id) machine_id, shared.niveau_depuis_rul(rul_predit) AS risk_level_predit

WHERE risk_level_predit = 'a_risque'
